def compute_reward(obs):
    """Dense progress term plus goal bonus and a small step cost."""
    gx, gy = obs["goal"]
    before = abs(gx - obs["pos"][0]) + abs(gy - obs["pos"][1])
    after = abs(gx - obs["next_pos"][0]) + abs(gy - obs["next_pos"][1])
    parts = {"progress": 0.1 * (before - after), "goal": 1.0 if obs["reached"] else 0.0, "step": -0.01}
    return sum(parts.values()), parts
